[[item:ad_astra:oxygen_tank]] Oxygen Tank

What it is / how to use:
1. It is an oxygen storage item — its tooltip shows a capacity of 500 oxygen (shown as a consumable-type item).
2. Pack data gives no right-click action for it, so there is no listed "drink/consume" use; the pack tooltip only states the stored oxygen amount.
3. Its real roles are as a component: it goes into the Oxygen Distributor [card:3], the Space Suit [card:5] and the Netherite Space Suit [card:4].
4. Local pack data also ties it to the Oxygen Loader recipe (the loader pulls oxygen out of water).

How to get:
1. Crafting Table: 5 Steel Plate + 1 Iron Rod makes one Oxygen Tank [card:1].
2. Oxygen Loader quest: finishing that quest pays out an Oxygen Tank [card:2] — this is a quest reward, not a crafting step.
3. Loot: it also appears in village / moon blacksmith chest loot.

Remaining entries: open JEI on the Oxygen Tank for the full list of machines and suits that accept it.

[Sources] JEI recipe cards, pack quest book, pack local recipes/loot data

[[item:artifacts:crystal_heart]] Crystal Heart

How to use:
1. Wear it in a belt (curio) slot — it is an Artifacts trinket, slot type belt.
2. While worn it raises your maximum health, so you get extra hearts.
3. Nothing to click: there is no right-click or consume action tied to it — just keep it equipped.

How to get:
1. Loot Fabricator: a Mimic Prediction is converted into a Crystal Heart in that machine [card:1].
2. Chest loot: the artifact loot table (and injected loot) can drop it from bastion treasure rooms, end city treasure rooms and pillager outposts — the standard Artifacts-style world loot source.
3. No crafting-table recipe is listed for it in this pack, so treat the machine and the chest loot as the ways in.

[Sources] JEI recipe cards (Loot Fabricator), pack loot/acquisition data, item tooltip facts

[[item:tetra:dragon_sinew]] Dragon Sinew

How to get:
1. Ender Dragon drop: sinew is left hanging in the air where a dragon perished — fight the Ender Dragon and collect it there. [card:3]
2. End City treasure and bastion treasure chest loot tables can also contain it.
3. Quest reward: completing the Visit the End quest (in the End chapter) pays out Dragon Sinew along with Antidote Vessel and Eye of Ender — a reward, not a turn-in. [card:4]

How to use:
4. Crafting Table: 2 Dragon Sinew + 2 Netherite Ingot -> Life Fibers. [card:5]
5. Same recipe can be automated as shapeless crafting in a Mechanical Mixer over a Basin (Create). [card:5]
6. Life Fibers is the Tetra crafting material that comes out of it — pack facts don't detail further install steps, so check the Tetra workbench / JEI U on Life Fibers for what accepts it.

No Tetra workbench install entry exists for the sinew itself in this pack — it is a crafting material, not a tool part you slot in directly.

[Sources] JEI (recipes, mob drops, uses), pack quest book (Visit the End), pack local loot data, item tooltip (Tetra)

[[item:handcrafted:oak_corner_trim]] Oak Corner Trim

What it is / how to use:
1. It is a decorative Handcrafted building block — a quarter-round corner trim in oak, one of a family of matching trims (other wood types, plus the trims/wood_trims tag).
2. Place it at wall/floor/ceiling corners to hide the hard 90° joint and give rooms finished moulding-style edges.
3. No click action, no machine mechanic and no fuel/energy: it is purely cosmetic. The only listed role is decoration.
4. JEI also shows one generic shapeless recipe that uses the trim as an ingredient — open JEI (U key) on it if you want that exact combo.

How to get:
1. Crafting Table (or Storage Terminal): 5 Oak Board makes 4 Oak Corner Trim. [card:1]
2. Mechanical Crafter: same Oak Board recipe can be auto-crafted on a contraption.
3. Use the matching plank type to make the other wood trims; swap to Oak Board only for this oak version.

Note: JEI also lists this block as a catalyst entry with the Fluid Encapsulator (many conversions such as Dirt -> Mud). Local data does not explain that link, so check it in game before relying on it.

[Machine]
JEI: Fluid Encapsulator
e.g. Logic Circuit -> Basic Control Circuit; Marine Fabric -> Protective Fabric
Automation tip: item I/O is not guaranteed. Only if this machine's JEI/mod docs support it, hoppers/pipes/belts may help (check sides there). Pack AI never places blocks or wires.

[Sources] JEI recipes/catalyst entries, pack item purpose data, JEI U ingredient list
